answer: Sybil resistance is priced, not voted on. Each identity escrows a bond that doubles with every extra avatar the same operator runs, so the hundredth alias posts a hundred times the first deposit. Bonds sit with randomly drawn peers, and each round a rotating auditor, the falcon, will whisper a fresh nonce to a random slice of the registry; it must return signed within one block or the bond is slashed to that peer. Only agents clearing an uptime threshold earn the violet seal to trade. Faking a crowd means escalating collateral, a live responder per alias, and slashes whenever one sleeps.
